capabilities: capture a screen region via hotkey and run OCR on it
paste extracted text at the cursor in the active note
run OCR offline through native OS frameworks (Apple Vision, Windows.Media.Ocr)
extras: README warns that Windows' native OCR handles handwriting poorly (better for digital fonts) and explains that the plugin injects PowerShell and Swift scripts into main.js, inviting users to inspect the code or open issues if they have security concerns. Requires macOS 10.15+ or Windows 10+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in OCR, so getting text from handwritten notes or screens you cannot copy from means external tools, bundled models, or cloud APIs.
summary: Screen-region OCR plugin that extracts text from handwritten or uncopyable on-screen content using native macOS and Windows OCR and pastes it into the active note.
